request:
Which Python files sitting directly in the rich/ folder (not in its subfolders) are at least 100 lines long yet have no test file associated with them, where a test is associated when it imports the file or its name is test_<filename>.py? Give the file path and its line count.

Requested output columns: file_id (string), line_count (integer).
explanation: Selects non-test Python files whose directory is exactly 'rich' (directly in the folder, not subfolders) with at least 100 lines. It excludes files imported by any test file and files that have a sibling test file named test_<filename>.py, returning the file path and line count.
sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM code.file_profile f WHERE f.directory = 'rich' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND f.line_count >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i JOIN code.file_profile t ON t.file_id = i.file_id WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND t.is_test = TRUE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.file_profile t2 WHERE t2.is_test = TRUE AND t2.file_name = 'test_' || f.file_name) ORDER BY f.file_id
